frequency_question: What proportion of nominated agency heads successfully secure confirmation floor votes resulting in approval?
membership_rule: Includes formal presidential nominations of Senate-confirmed civilian executive branch positions in health and human services agencies; excludes interim or acting appointments that never received formal floor consideration.
window: From formal nomination submission to a maximum of 14 months or end of congressional session.
coverage_note: 12 named recent health agency head nominations; historical baseline shows withdrawal is rare though delays occur.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier deputy positions which face different confirmation dynamics.
validity_reason: Relies on institutional norms of Senate confirmation for health posts which remain relatively stable across presidential cycles.
